guidebook.intro: Yogera ku nyanja, emiga, ebibira n’ensozi, n’okukuuma ensi yafe.

tips.title: In, on, at
body: **Mu** kitera okuba **in**: **in the forest**, **in the lake**. **Ku** kitera okuba **on**: **on the hill**. Ku bifo: **in Jinja** oba **at Jinja**.
**From** kiraga gye kiva: **Fish come from the lake.**

tips.title: “Let’s …”
body: Mu Lusoga **tu-** ku ntandikwa n’**-e** ku nkomerero: **tusimbe**, **tukuume**. Mu Lungereza **Let’s**: **Let’s plant trees! Let’s protect our land.**

culture.title: Ensozi omusanvu
body: **Kampala was built on seven hills**: Mengo, Kasubi, Kibuli, Namirembe, Lubaga, Nsambya ne Kampala yenyini. Ate e Jinja: **the source of the Nile**.
